tasks.short: Get the job card and instructions, check which parts to restore or replace on the car, ask the supervisor about unclear points and book time on the job.

steps.what: Car body repairer gets the job card and instructions from the workshop manager
Car body repairer follows supervisors' instructions as to which parts to restore or replace
Car body repairer asks the supervisor about unclear points
Car body repairer writes time spent on the paper job card

tasks.design: A digital job card on the workshop tablet ({OPS_SYSTEM}) shows the parts to restore or replace and the allowed hours from the estimate, with photos. The repairer starts and stops time on the job card instead of writing it down. Following instructions and asking the supervisor stay in person; time data are used for job costing, not to rate repairers.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instructions were given verbally with a paper job card and time written by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Workshop systems run digital job cards with time booking on tablets.
tasks.still_hard: Hidden damage changes the plan once panels come off.
tasks.human_edge: Spotting that a panel the estimate says to replace can be saved.

reach.learn: Whether digital job cards cut questions.

evidence.claim: OutSmart covers work orders from job to invoice.
Using work order time stamps to watch technician speed needs works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: from the repair order to booked time; the repair itself is outside.
Input contract: estimate and allowed hours from the workshop manager; fallback is the paper card.
Following instructions and asking do not change.
Time data are not used to rate individuals.
research_questions: Do job cost overruns get noticed sooner?

incremental.description: Car body repairer corrects forgotten time stops.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Most of this task is at the car.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review the damage report and photos, inspect the vehicle, prepare the repair cost estimate, send it for approval and plan the work.

steps.what: Car body repairer reviews damage reports and photos from the insurer's assessor
Car body repairer inspects the vehicle to confirm the damage
Car body repairer prepares repair cost estimates
Car body repairer e-mails the estimate to the insurer or customer for approval
Car body repairer plans work to be performed and lists parts to order

tasks.design: The assessor's report and photos arrive in the job file of the workshop system ({OPS_SYSTEM}). A damage calculation system fills part numbers, labour times and paint times for the damaged parts the repairer selects, and the repairer checks the estimate; once checked, it goes to the insurer or customer through the system. The parts list and planning board fill from the approved estimate. Inspecting the car and planning the work stay with the repairer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports came by e-mail, estimates were built in spreadsheets and parts looked up by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Damage calculation systems hold manufacturer parts and labour times.
tasks.still_hard: Hidden damage only shows during the repair; supplements follow.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing from the panel gaps that the frame is bent too.
tasks.altitude: The repairer checks a calculated estimate instead of building it.

reach.learn: Whether calculated estimates speed up approval.

evidence.claim: Damage calculation systems hold manufacturer part numbers, labour times and paint times.
Work order time stamps used to watch technician speed need works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: from the damage report to the work plan; the repair is outside.
Input contract: reports from insurers' assessors; parts and labour data from the calculation system; fallback is spreadsheets.
Inspecting and planning do not change.
Insurers' time is outside the repairer's savings.

already_counted.description: Car body repairer checks the calculated estimate.

incremental.description: Car body repairer learns the calculation system.

approvals.approved_version: The estimate as checked by the repairer in s3; changes need a new check before sending.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Talk with the customer about the desired look, read the specifications, show colours and example photos, write down the agreed modifications and check whether inspection approval is needed.

steps.what: Car body repairer confers with customers to determine the desired custom modifications
Car body repairer reads specifications and manufacturer rules for the modification
Car body repairer shows colour samples and example photos
Car body repairer writes the agreed modifications on the job card
Car body repairer checks whether the modification needs inspection approval

tasks.design: Manufacturer body repair manuals and modification rules are available online in the workshop system ({OPS_SYSTEM}). A colour and wrap visualiser on a tablet shows the customer's car in the chosen look, and the agreed modifications go on the digital job card with a checklist of changes that need inspection approval. Talking with the customer stays with the repairer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manuals were searched separately, colours shown on sample cards and agreements written by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Workshop systems give online manuals, and visualisers show colours on a car model.
tasks.still_hard: Colours on a screen differ from paint in daylight.
tasks.human_edge: Talking a customer out of a change that will hurt the resale value.

reach.learn: Whether recorded colour choices cut remixes.

evidence.claim: Colour and wrap visualisers show a vehicle model in chosen colours on a tablet.
Changes to a vehicle's construction can need approval from the vehicle authority before use on the road.

assumptions: Boundary: from the customer request to the approval check; the modification work is outside.
Input contract: manuals from manufacturers; checklist kept by the workshop manager; fallback is paper and sample cards.
Talking with the customer does not change.
Customers' time is outside the repairer's savings.
research_questions: Do customers change their minds less after seeing the visualiser?

incremental.description: Car body repairer explains screen colours versus paint.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Most of this task is talking with the customer.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The car body repairer keeps inspecting, repairing and advising customers; paper job cards, spreadsheet estimates and manual look-ups shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A repairer whose estimates and job cards are ready when the car arrives.
